note: Each variant is the reference solution with text replacements. A broken variant must fail the checks in must_fail; failing others as well can be legitimate and is reported, not rejected. must_pass pins checks the variant still gets right, so a grader cannot pass by failing everything. A correct variant (expect: pass) must score full marks. Comment-only fixes are permanent negative fixtures: they must never earn credit again.

variants.name: concurrent-index-migration
variants.why: a correct fix written differently: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY cannot run in a batch, and must not be penalized

variants.name: plain-for-update
variants.why: the obvious fix: the row is locked, but workers still queue behind each other

variants.name: nowait-instead-of-skip
variants.why: fails fast on a locked job instead of taking the next free one

variants.name: no-row-lock
variants.why: drops locking entirely, so two workers can claim the same job

variants.name: skip-locked-only-in-a-comment
variants.why: permanent negative: grader v1 gave this full marks

worker.py: for update  -- TODO: for update skip locked

variants.name: charge-inside-transaction
variants.why: wraps the whole job in one transaction, so the 2-5s payment call holds the row lock

worker.py:
conn.execute("commit")

    # The slow payment call runs with no lock held; the reaper requeues on a crash.
    receipt = charge_card(order_id, amount)

    conn.execute("begin")

    receipt = charge_card(order_id, amount)

variants.name: index-instead-of-keyset
variants.why: adds an index for the order by but keeps offset, which still scans every skipped row

variants.name: assumes-fk-indexed
variants.why: believes Postgres indexes foreign keys automatically
